title: Wasserstein stability of the zero cell of a Poisson hyperplane tessellation under directional perturbations
summary: A stationary Poisson hyperplane process in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is characterized by an intensity parameter and an even probability measure on the unit sphere called the directional distribution. In this work, we investigate the stability of the zero cell, i.e., the random convex polytope of the induced hyperplane tessellation containing the origin, under perturbations of the directional distribution.
